explainTr: Past Continuous (was/were + V-ing) geçmişte belli bir anda süren eylemi anlatır: At 8 o'clock, I was walking to school. Eylemin başı ve sonu önemli değildir, o an ne olduğu önemlidir.
I/he/she/it ile was, you/we/they ile were kullanılır. Olumsuz: wasn't / weren't + V-ing. Soru: Was he sleeping? What were you doing?
Past Continuous olay anlatırken sahneyi kurar: It was snowing, and people were walking. Hemen ardından Past Simple ile asıl olay gelir (yarın göreceğiz).
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'yürüyordum' tek kelimedir ve geçmişte süren eylemi anlatır. İngilizcede 'I was walking' iki parçadır: was + yürümek-ing. Özneye göre was/were seçmeyi unutma.

examples.en: At eight o'clock, I was walking to school.
It was snowing, and the parking lot was slippery.
She was carrying two heavy boxes.
We weren't running in the hallway.
What were you doing at noon?

reading.title: An accident in the parking lot
reading.text:
Last Friday morning, Hafsa was walking to the school office. It was 7:45, and it was snowing lightly. The parking lot was slippery. A new teacher, Ms. Diaz, was walking ahead of her. She was carrying two heavy boxes of books, and she was talking on her phone.

Suddenly, Ms. Diaz slipped on the ice and fell. The boxes flew out of her hands, and books were lying all over the ground. Hafsa dropped her bag and ran to her. "Are you hurt?" she asked. "My ankle," Ms. Diaz said. "I can't stand up."

Other people were walking into the building, but nobody noticed the accident. Hafsa called loudly, and Mr. Brown came out of the office. He was holding a coffee, but he put it down at once. He called an ambulance while Hafsa stayed with Ms. Diaz. The teacher was crying, so Hafsa held her hand and spoke slowly. "Don't panic. Help is coming," she said.

The ambulance arrived in ten minutes. Later, Mr. Brown asked Hafsa to write a short report because she was the only witness. She wrote: "It was snowing. Ms. Diaz was carrying boxes, and she was not looking at the ground. She slipped near the front door."

"Thank you, Hafsa," Mr. Brown said. "You stayed calm, and that was very important."

questions.q: What was Ms. Diaz doing when she fell?
options: Carrying boxes and talking on her phone
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'carrying two heavy boxes... talking on her phone'.

questions.q: What did Hafsa do after the accident?
options: She stayed with Ms. Diaz and held her hand.
She picked up the books first.
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'Hafsa held her hand and spoke slowly'.

questions.q: Why did Mr. Brown ask Hafsa to write a report?
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'because she was the only witness'.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Hafsa, thank you for helping this morning. I need to fill out an incident form.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Of course. What do you need to know?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: What time did the accident happen?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Around a quarter to eight. I was walking to the office.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: What was Ms. Diaz doing at that moment?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: She was carrying two boxes, and she was talking on her phone.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: No. A custodian was cleaning the back entrance, but he wasn't looking at her.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: And what was the ground like?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: It was icy. It was snowing, and nobody was putting salt on the path.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Thank you. I will ask the custodian to put salt there every morning.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: That's a good idea. Is Ms. Diaz going to be okay?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: I think so. It was only a small injury, but she needs to rest for a week.

questions.whyTr: Hafsa: 'I was walking to the office.'

questions.q: What will Mr. Brown ask the custodian to do?
options: Put salt on the path every morning
questions.whyTr: Mr. Brown: 'put salt there every morning'.

writing.promptTr: Gördüğün ya da hayal ettiğin küçük bir olayı anlatan kısa bir rapor yaz (80-120 kelime). was/were + V-ing ile o anda ne olduğunu anlat.
writing.promptEn: Write a short report about a small accident you saw or imagine. Describe what people were doing.
writing.model:
Yesterday at 8:15 a.m., I was walking to the school office. The weather was cold, and the floor in the hallway was wet. A student was running, and his friend was following him. Another child was carrying a big backpack.

Suddenly the boy slipped and fell. He was not hurt badly, but he was crying. Nobody else was walking in the hallway, so I called the secretary. Mr. Brown came quickly, and I stayed with the boy.

I think the floor was dangerous because the custodian was not working there that morning. A warning sign could help.

Hafsa
checklistTr: Anı anlatırken was/were + V-ing kullandın mı?
Özneye göre was ve were'ı doğru seçtin mi?
Sahneyi anlatan (weather, floor) cümleler var mı?
